value.rationale: The original 2022 three-term progression work identifies irregularity after p=floor(a/2). The theorem gives an explicit infinite beyond-range regime where a central structural semigroup invariant, maximal embedding dimension, systematically fails. The exact multiplicity and parity-sensitive local gap witnesses supply a substantive boundary phenomenon rather than a finite table, tautological reformulation, or one-off cheap negative test. It does not assert a sharp first failure threshold.
